tools.name: search
tools.description: Find notices, showcase entries and Toolbox tools by a few words, for example 'stripe refund', 'delete user data', 'supabase access rules' or 'multiplayer game'. Use this first when you know what the person is about to do. Returns the best matches with their ids; call get_notice for one in full.

tools.name: list_notices
tools.description: List the safety and upkeep notices: title, topic, who each one is for, a summary and its id. Pass the tool the person builds with to get only what applies to it. Use this before work on login, payments, personal data or deleting data, and when asked what to check before going live. Call get_notice w

tools.name: get_notice
tools.description: One notice or showcase entry as Markdown: whether it applies, the problem, what could happen, the steps with the messages to paste, and every source it is based on.

tools.name: list_tool_updates
tools.description: Where each AI building tool announces changes and security fixes, and whether it keeps a dated list of security fixes.

tools.name: list_showcase
tools.description: Real games, rebuilt apps and tools that people made mainly with AI coding tools: who built it and with what, and a summary. Use it when the person wants ideas, asks what is possible, or doubts they can build something. Each entry rests on the builder's own account and another source; the projects ar

tools.name: list_toolbox
tools.description: Tools that already exist, add-ons for AI coding tools, safety tools, and popular tools to be careful with. Each has a plain description, its licence, when it was last updated and any caution. Being listed is not a safety check.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
